_note: Confirmed by management 8 Oct 2026 (sales & pricing policy Oct 2026). Site-wide pricing rules; per-room base_price lives in rooms.json.
price_basis: board rate — per night, incl. VAT; room-only plan unless the rate plan says breakfast is included
display_reason: price varies by season and by day of week; a daily rate calendar comes in phase 2 (pricing_mode: calendar)
display_ar: يبدأ من {price} ريال / الليلة — شامل الضريبة

breakfast.display_rule: next to the price show «شامل الإفطار» if the rate plan includes it, else «الإفطار 20 ريال»

children.ar: الأطفال حتى 5 سنوات مجانًا، ومن 6 إلى 12 سنة بنصف السعر (10 ريالات)، وفوق 12 سنة بسعر البالغ.
children.en: Children up to 5 eat free; ages 6 to 12 at half price (SAR 10); over 12 at the adult rate.

1_starting_from.rule: site shows base_price as «يبدأ من»; reception confirms the final price on booking

2_rate_calendar.rule: admin rate calendar: reception sets price per day per room type; site reads price for the selected dates

3_channel_manager.rule: channel manager syncs rates + availability with Booking.com and other platforms; «يبدأ من» dropped, real price per date shown

rate_plans._note: Breakfast lives on the rate plan, never on the room. Each room lists which plans it sells with that plan's base_price. Phase 2 `rates` rows carry rate_plan_code. Phase 1: only room_only is rendered; breakfast shown as an add-on «الإفطار 20 ريال للشخص في اليوم». bed_and_breakfast is defined for phase 2 (rate calendar) and carries no prices yet.
